column7: ResumeSecret reactivated a suspended secret inside a deleted environment (DeleteEnvironment counts only active secrets). It now follows the create-path live-parent protocol: withEnvironmentSecretGuard (named lock plus in-lock environment existence check) and the status write plus a LockLiveProject re-read in one transaction. Cross-replica half: TestCTAReview_ResumeSecret_vs_DeleteEnvironment_CrossReplicaPostgres (pg-gated); ResumeSecret joins TestProjectChildWrites_RecheckProjectLivenessInATransaction.
